module: D09-13 Industry Structure／Porter Five Forces產業結構與波特五力

marketDefinition.label: Taiwan-headquartered IC foundry industry output
marketDefinition.definitionNote: TSIA states industry output is calculated based on companies headquartered in Taiwan.
marketDefinition.caveat: Industry production value is not assumed identical to any issuer's consolidated accounting revenue.

industryState.implication: Foundry is a dominant component of Taiwan-headquartered IC manufacturing output, but this does not by itself identify firm-level market shares.

firmCapabilityPanel.name: TSMC
firmCapabilityPanel.geographicCapacity: Taiwan plus Nanjing, Arizona, Japan and other overseas facilities
firmCapabilityPanel.structureUse: barrier / scale / technology breadth / customer diversification evidence

firmCapabilityPanel.name: UMC
firmCapabilityPanel.processFocus: logic and specialty technologies; down to 14nm in Taiwan Fab 12A with broad mature/specialty portfolio
firmCapabilityPanel.geographicCapacity: most core 12/8-inch fabs and R&D in Taiwan plus Singapore, Xiamen and Japan
firmCapabilityPanel.structureUse: rivalry / differentiated node-product positioning / geographic-capacity evidence

rivalry.evidence: TSMC emphasizes leading-edge/advanced technology scale while UMC emphasizes mature/specialty logic platforms; competition is not one homogeneous wafer market.

evidence: large wafer-fab capacity and multi-year expansion

substitutes.evidence: Different process nodes/specialty platforms are not perfect substitutes; exact cross-elasticity and qualification switching are not in current receipt.

supplierPower.evidence: No common PIT supplier concentration/critical-input denominator frozen in this receipt.

buyerPower.evidence: TSMC reports 534 customers and diversified end markets, but customer concentration/contract leverage comparable across firms is not frozen here.

denominatorFirewall.forbiddenCalculation: TSMC consolidated revenue / TSIA foundry production value as a formal market-share estimate
reason: industry production value and issuer consolidated accounting revenue are not yet proven identical measurement constructs
firm geographic/facility scope and industry methodology require explicit compatibility audit
node/product mix and value per wafer differ, so capacity share is not revenue share
candidateOnlyDiagnostics: TSMC and UMC revenue values may be stored for later scope reconciliation but not labeled market share.
TSMC >17m annual 12-inch-equivalent capacity and UMC >400k/month capacity cannot be turned into total-industry capacity share because the complete denominator is absent.

positiveMechanism: Scale, process breadth, yield learning, customer qualification and capital requirements form observable entry-barrier dimensions.
Different node/product portfolios create segmented rivalry rather than one undifferentiated foundry market.
Official TSIA output plus issuer-native capacity/product/customer data are sufficient to replay a bounded industry-structure state.
falsification: High output growth does not prove every foundry earns excess returns.
Scale is not sufficient for competitive advantage if utilization, technology relevance or price discipline deteriorates.
Mature-node and leading-edge foundry capacity are not perfect substitutes.
A large consolidated-revenue issuer cannot be assigned market share without a compatible industry denominator.
Overseas fab expansion can strengthen geographic resilience while diluting margin or changing cost structure.

pitSemantics.issuerSources: 2025 annual reports / 2026 annual-report filings and current official company capability pages
pitSemantics.firstEligibleDecision: No earlier than each source publication/capture; no 2025 backdating for later-published annual results.
pitSemantics.revisionRule: Append revised TSIA/issuer vintages; never overwrite earlier captured states.

promotionReason: A replayable Taiwan-headquartered foundry industry state can now be built from TSIA/ITRI output data plus issuer-native capacity, technology, product and customer evidence with explicit denominator firewalls and UNKNOWN handling. Exact firm market share and predictive efficacy remain unproven.
reasonNoL4: No prospective/OOS relationship to returns, margins or stock-selection outcomes; supplier/buyer power and exact market-share denominators remain incomplete.
exactNext: BR-052 redesign under H01 SCOPE_DEDUP_ONLY as a firm-specific competitive-action/position receipt rather than duplicating static industry structure.
Add one non-semiconductor priority industry as negative/control comparison before cross-industry scoring.
Do not create a Five-Forces composite score or market-share factor before redundancy and OOS tests.
